Proposition
[elementary parabolic variant] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0088 1. ch10:10.81\group ABP maximum principles

If $(\partial _t-a^{ij} abla _i abla _j)u\le F(u,x,t)$, $u\le k$ on the parabolic boundary, and $F(z,x,t)\le Az$ for $z\le K$, then \[ u\le K\quad ext{on }\Omega _{T_1},\qquad T_1=\min \{ T,A^{-1}\log (K/k)\} . \]
Proof

\sketch Let $m(t)=\max _{\Omega _t}u$. Before the first time $m$ reaches $K$, the scalar maximum principle applied to $u_t-a^{ij} abla _i abla _ju\le Au$ gives $m(t)\le ke^{At}$. This is $<K$ for $t<T_1$, contradiction.

□
